start.title: Forty Days
start.text:
Forty days without bread.
The desert is silent.

curse_consequence.title: Endure
curse_consequence.text:
The Father has led you here.
Kneel in trust.

leave_consequence.title: Stay
leave_consequence.text:
This trial must be faced.
Return to prayer.

bread.title: The First Voice
bread.text:
A voice whispers:
"Turn these stones into bread."

choices.text: "Man lives by every word of God."

obey_bread_consequence.title: Resist Hunger
obey_bread_consequence.text:
Power is not for self.
Speak the truth.

choices.text: "Man lives by every word of God."

pinnacle.title: On the Pinnacle
pinnacle.text:
He sets you on the temple.
"Throw yourself down. Angels will catch you."

choices.text: "Do not put God to the test."

leap_consequence.title: Stand Firm
leap_consequence.text:
Faith is not a spectacle.
Answer with truth.

choices.text: "Do not put God to the test."

boast_consequence.title: Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
Trust does not need proof.
Speak the word.

choices.text: "Do not put God to the test."

kingdoms.title: All the Kingdoms
kingdoms.text:
He shows the world below.
"Bow to me and all is yours."

bow_consequence.title: Serve God Alone
bow_consequence.text:
No throne is worth your soul.
Speak the truth.

bargain_consequence.title: No Compromise
bargain_consequence.text:
Truth has no price.
Stand firm.

departs.title: He Departs
departs.text:
The tempter fades into the dust.
Silence returns.

chase_consequence.title: Be Still
chase_consequence.text:
The battle is finished.
Rest in the Father.

rest.title: Angels Minister
rest.text:
Dawn rises gently.
The truth has prevailed.
